risks.risk: Console model may not be Xbox One (could be another Xbox generation), which changes compatibility and value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console label/serial/model text on the back or bottom (or the 'Xbox One' branding on the console) plus a boot screen photo.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic Xbox console with unknown model and unverified functionality.

risks.risk: Adaptor/power issue may mean the console won’t power on at all, or may be a deeper PSU fault.
risks.proof: Video clip of the console powering on using the correct adapter (showing the Xbox logo/boot screen).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working / needs power fix until proven otherwise.

risks.risk: Controller may be non-functional (drift, broken buttons) or not included as stated.
risks.proof: Video clip showing controller connected and working in a game/menu (button presses + joystick movement).
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming controller is included but untested.

risks.risk: Games may not be included, may be scratched, or may not be the exact titles claimed (including 'fc').
risks.proof: Photos of all 6 game discs/cases (front/back) or a screenshot list from the console showing installed games.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the console model/label (back/bottom) showing it is Xbox One.
Video of power-on with the correct adapter showing the boot screen.
Video showing the controller connected and responding (menu navigation).
Photos of the 6 games (discs/cases) or a screenshot showing the game library.
response.reason: The photos confirm an Xbox-style controller and a console, but the exact Xbox One model and the adaptor issue are not verifiable, and no games are shown. To price correctly in Abuja, we need proof of model and working/power status.
